# Arguments every `codex exec` call in the review gets, one per line (blank lines and lines
# starting with # are skipped). Read by .github/workflows/codex-review.yml (bounded reviewer) and
# scripts/codex-review-run-chunks.py (chunked reviewer), so the two cannot drift.
#
# The model reads PR-authored text, so it gets no way to act on anything: all the evidence it
# needs is already in the prompt. Verified against @openai/codex 0.160.0 (the pinned version):
# `features.shell_tool=false` removes both command tools (exec_command and write_stdin); the
# `unified_exec` feature still reports enabled but only changes how the shell tool runs.
# Codex accepts unknown keys silently, so the codex-review-tests CI job installs the pinned
# version and asserts each feature below is really off.
--ephemeral
--skip-git-repo-check
--ignore-user-config
--sandbox
read-only
-c
web_search="disabled"
-c
features.shell_tool=false
-c
features.view_image=false
-c
features.browser_use=false
-c
features.browser_use_external=false
-c
features.browser_use_full_cdp_access=false
-c
features.computer_use=false
-c
features.in_app_browser=false
-c
features.apps=false
-c
features.plugins=false
-c
features.hooks=false
-c
features.multi_agent=false
-c
features.image_generation=false
-c
features.tool_suggest=false
-c
features.skill_mcp_dependency_install=false
-c
features.workspace_dependencies=false
